contexts.text: (These states) are recalled in the other life.
The truth which has been implanted through affection is recalled through affection: and, when this truth is recalled, the affection is presented...
The things said before should be recalled.
So when the scientific is recalled, the good conjoined with it comes forth.
Not by a sensible recalling from the memory.
That they might recall this subject from their (former) ideas.
Spirits are not permitted to recall anything (from the memory of past things).
On the recalling of a man's states.
That persons are recalled together with the idea...
There are Spirits who... recall filthy things to see whether another Spirit still thinks such things... SE 4395:end.
The voluntary things... of the exterior memory... they are not allowed to recall into use. Those who are permitted to recall them are the unhappy...
All man's states can be recalled after death...
